integrity: Proof is analytic; bundled code checks finite numerical instances only, with no claim of infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed two equal-cardinality regular orbits, unequal positive radii, Hardy and unweighted Bergman kernel only; no arbitrary-node assertion. Priority requires independent confirmation; DFT and Cauchy determinant are classical.
title: Simultaneous spectral-optimal staggering of two Hardy and Bergman kernel polygons
